repair: terminal-only reclaim plus explicit capacity rejection

pre_fix_failure: new setpoint replaced active_command_id without terminal old status
root_cause: takeover mutated axis ownership before replacement outcome

pre_fix_failure: first failed axis prevented stop attempts on later axes
root_cause: interrupting operations returned from the first failure
repair: three-axis best-effort dispatch with aggregate/per-axis evidence

pre_fix_failure: session became disconnected without retaining individual stop failures
root_cause: disconnect ignored stop results and cancelled too early
repair: failure diagnostics and cancel only on successful axis stop

pre_fix_failure: large deadline gaps required repeated catch-up and runtime hid lateness with scheduled time
root_cause: linear deadline loop plus stale timestamp authority
repair: overflow-safe O(1) advancement and actual now_us core tick
regression: core deadline_large_gap plus runtime actual-time assertion

pre_fix_failure: near-UINT32_MAX length could cause attacker-sized discard work and runtime ignored fatal feed
repair: immediate RESYNC_REQUIRED latch session close and runtime fault
regression: frame hostile prefix plus runtime fatal ingress

pre_fix_failure: reboot retained old dictionary/SDO state and no-first-heartbeat did not time out
root_cause: node epoch and monitor start were incomplete
repair: boot invalidation active-SDO cancellation and first-heartbeat timer

pre_fix_failure: ordinary heartbeat could hide an EMCY fault
repair: FAULT persists until boot-up epoch or reviewed clear policy

pre_fix_failure: magic-only validation could preserve incompatible RAM
root_cause: retention had no schema size or checksum contract

pre_fix_failure: monotonic read forced IRQ enable and faults lacked actionable context
root_cause: target concerns were embedded in main and fault handler retained enum only
repair: target time/fault seam exact PRIMASK restore and stacked/SCB capture
regression: GNU+ArmClang builds and behavioral fault-frame C test

pre_fix_failure: internal health stop could be cleared by enable or reconnect and was not retried
root_cause: one shared protective flag and premature retry latch
repair: non-clearable internal latch ERROR/FAULT state and repeated three-axis attempts
regression: core reconnect/enable rejection plus runtime 2x per-axis retry

pre_fix_failure: ready watchdog could refresh without a valid current safety sample
root_cause: watchdog gate checked liveness but not safety sample authority
repair: valid healthy safety sample required; expected-port read failure faults

pre_fix_failure: future physical PC command could be serviced before first health sample in the same scheduler step
root_cause: mainline preceded health with no ingress safety gate
repair: expected safety port requires last valid healthy non-asserted sample before ingress
